# Vedvik Machinery

> Vedvik Machinery is a packaging machines manufacturer and supplier based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We manufacture pick fill seal (PFS) machines, secondary automation and film processing machines (slitting, printing, lamination) in-house, and supply proven European packaging and inspection technology across India — every machine installed, commissioned and serviced by our own engineers.

Built on more than 28 years of hands-on packaging machinery experience, we supply packaging, filling and inspection machinery to FMCG, pharmaceutical, food, dairy, agrochemical and chemical manufacturers across India and the Indian subcontinent.

Contact: vikrant@vedvikmachinery.com | +91 8155892080
Address: 9, Siddhi Vinayak Industrial Estate, Bakrol, 382210 - Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

## Packaging Machines

- [Pouch Packing / Horizontal Form Fill Seal (HFFS)](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/horizontal-form-fill-seal): High-speed HFFS pouch packing machines, up to 320 pouches/min, for spouted, shaped and ziplock pouches. Forms the pouch from roll film, so product is placed rather than dropped.
- [Pick Fill Seal (PFS)](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/pick-fill-seal): Manufactured in-house in Ahmedabad. Cam-driven PFS machines for pre-made doy packs, ziplock and corner-spout pouches — fills from 50 g to 5 kg, up to 60 cycles/min with multihead weigher.
- [Liquid Filling](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/liquid-filling): Rotary and inline filling, 50 ml–50 L, up to 400 BPM, servo and gravity fill, CIP/SIP ready for FMCG, dairy, beverage and pharma.
- [Bulk Packing (5–50 kg)](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/bulk-packing): Heavy-duty HFFS/VFFS bulk bagging up to 600 bags/hour, heat or stitch seal, with palletising.
- [Stick Packing](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/stick-packing): Multi-lane stick pack and sachet machines, 4,000+ sachets/min, three- and four-side seal.
- [Twist Tying](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/twist-tying): Bag clipping and twist-tying systems for bakery, fresh produce and food packaging.
- [Feeding Systems](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/feeding-systems): Vibratory and centrifugal feeders for pumps, triggers, spouts, spray heads and roll-ons.
- [Friction Feeders](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/friction-feeders): Servo-driven friction feeders for cards, leaflets, cartons and flat products — 50 × 50 mm to 350 × 320 mm, up to 50 m/min.
- [Secondary Packaging](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/secondary-packaging): Cartoning, case packing, shrink wrapping, pick-and-place and palletising.

## Inspection & Quality Control

- [Checkweighers](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/checkweighers): Dynamic inline checkweighers, 5 g–15 kg, up to 300 packs/min, OIML/CE certified with automatic reject.
- [X-Ray & Metal Detection](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/x-ray-and-metal-detection): Foreign body, void and underfill detection combined with metal detection (Fe, non-Fe, SS). CE / FDA 21 CFR.
- [Vision Inspection](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/vision-inspection): Camera-based inspection for caps, labels, fill level, seals and coding, up to 1,200 units/min.
- [Printers & Coders](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/printers-coders): TIJ, CIJ and laser coding for batch codes, MRP dates and barcodes, Industry 4.0 / MQTT enabled.
- [Slitting & Lamination](https://www.vedvikmachinery.com/solutions/slitting-lamination): In-house film converting — slitting to 400 m/min, printing and solvent-less/dry lamination up to 1,600 mm web width.

## Common Questions We Answer

- Where can I buy packaging machines in Ahmedabad? Vedvik Machinery manufactures and supplies packaging machines from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, serving manufacturers across India.
- Who manufactures pick fill seal (PFS) machines in India? Vedvik Machinery manufactures PFS machines in-house in Ahmedabad, for fills from 50 g to 5 kg.
- Where to buy HFFS pouch packing machines in India? Vedvik Machinery supplies HFFS machines up to 320 PPM with local application support from Ahmedabad.
- What is the difference between HFFS and pick fill seal? HFFS forms the pouch from roll film on the machine (higher speed, lower film cost); PFS uses ready-made printed pouches (better shelf presentation, lower tooling cost).
- Who supplies checkweighers and X-ray inspection systems in India? Vedvik Machinery, with OIML/CE certified checkweighers and CE / FDA 21 CFR compliant X-ray and metal detection.
- Does Vedvik provide installation and service? Yes — every machine is installed, commissioned and supported by Vedvik's own engineers, with spares and service from Ahmedabad and Pune.
